summary: Sprott Physical Gold Trust filed a Form 6-K containing its Interim Management Report of Fund Performance and Unaudited Interim Financial Statements as of March 31, 2026. The filing discloses routine operational results including unit issuances and redemptions under an at-the-market offering program, with no special-situation corporate transaction. The document is a periodic financial report for a closed-end fund, not an event-driven special situation. No deal terms or strategic actions are present.
